newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan chip makers, users keep Oct price flat - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan chip makers, users keep Oct price flat - paper.

text.p: Semiconductor makers and large-lot users in Japan, including computer manufacturers, have agreed on prices for 16 megabit DRAM chips for October delivery at 980 yen to 1,100 yen per chip, the same level as in September, a Japanese business daily reported on Thursday.
It is the first time in six months that chip prices have not declined from the previous month, suggesting that market conditions are improving, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Domestic chip prices firmed as overseas spot prices began rising due to growing demand from manufacuturers with the approach of the Christmas season, the paper said.
